Hyderabad Bouncers Allege Discrimination at Dandiya Events

In Hyderabad, bouncers have alleged that right-wing groups exerted pressure to prevent the employment of Muslims at Dandiya events during the Dasara Navaratri festival. The bouncers claim this discrimination has led to denial of work and is impacting their livelihoods, prompting calls for government intervention.
